property_summary: Reference C returns true from transfer(), while buggy M returns false from transfer() for any non-reverting call; concrete scenario: transfer with two non-zero-length arrays on a contract that accepts the call, so reference returns true and mutant returns false.
When calling transfer with an empty _tos array, the reference contract succeeds and returns true, but the buggy contract reverts due to require(_tos.length == 0).
Calling transfer with a non-empty _tos array succeeds on reference C but reverts on buggy M due to changed length check from >0 to ==0.
Calling transfer with a non-empty _tos array succeeds on reference C (returning true) but reverts on buggy M because require(_tos.length == 0) fails.
